operation.summary: Read the spending core: whether it is on (owner setting spending.core_enabled), which namespaces this build has, and for namespace=sandbox its switches, journal state and time anchor. With no namespace it answers for live, which is not available yet

query.name: namespace
query.description: live (the default) or sandbox. Only sandbox is available on this build; live is refused with platform_unsupported

operation.returns: enabled, setting, namespace, available, namespaces[], and for sandbox: switches{paused, device_paused, classes, sources}, payments_on, online, install, rules{generation, digest} or null, journal{epoch, origin, seq, whole, reset_reason, history_blocked, time{now, anchored, last_anchor_at, usable}}, read_at

namespace.description: live (the default) or sandbox. Only sandbox is available on this build; live is refused with platform_unsupported
